title: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
authors_zh: Xinyuan Wang 等 42 位作者
paper_type_zh: 跨平台计算机使用轨迹数据与开放构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究 computer-use agent、跨平台人类演示、多模态轨迹构造、反思式监督与数据审计的读者
one_line: OpenCUA turns 22,625 human desktop tasks into aligned screenshot-action traces with Claude-generated reflective supervision and releases the data, models, tools, and offline evaluator, while leaving full training and environment replay incomplete.
OpenCUA 将 22,625 个人类桌面任务处理为对齐的截图—动作轨迹并加入 Claude 合成的反思式监督，已发布数据、模型、工具和离线评测器，但完整训练与环境复现仍不完备。
why: For the Data Construction track, it makes collection, action reduction, visual-state matching, synthetic reflection, filtering, source mixing, and deployment evaluation separable audit objects instead of treating model benchmark gains as data quality.
inclusion_reason: OpenCUA exposes an unusually complete human-demonstration-to-training pipeline for computer-use data: cross-platform collection, event reduction, state-action alignment, reflective trace synthesis, mixed supervision, open artifacts, and explicit audit boundaries around privacy, replay, and post-hoc reasoning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Computer-use agents need more than isolated click labels: they must interpret a visual desktop, preserve task context over many steps, execute precise mouse and keyboard actions, recognize mistakes, and stop only when the goal is satisfied. Earlier resources often concentrate on one operating system, one application family, static GUI grounding, or synthetic environments, leaving limited open supervision for realistic cross-platform desktop work.

OpenCUA targets this data bottleneck with AgentNet, a corpus of 22,625 accepted human-demonstrated tasks on Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu. The paper reports more than 140 applications and 190 websites and summarizes the combined breadth as 200+ applications and websites. The construction problem is therefore not only collection at scale, but converting noisy low-level recordings into screenshot-action pairs, adding useful reflective supervision, and retaining enough provenance to audit privacy, rights, feedback quality, and replayability.

The central audit question is whether a released trace is valid for its intended use. A human action is not automatically optimal; a terminal task result does not validate every intermediate thought; an offline action match is not whole-task success; and a strong trained model is not proof that every data record is correct.

计算机使用智能体需要的并非孤立的点击标签：它必须理解可视化桌面，在多步过程中保持任务上下文，准确执行鼠标和键盘动作，识别错误，并且只在目标达成后终止。较早的资源常局限于单一操作系统、单一应用族、静态 GUI grounding 或合成环境，因此面向真实跨平台桌面工作的开放监督仍然有限。

OpenCUA 以 AgentNet 应对这一数据瓶颈。AgentNet 包含 22,625 个获接收的人类演示任务，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Ubuntu。论文报告其涉及 140 多个应用和 190 个网站，并将合并后的广度概括为 200 多个应用和网站。因此，构造问题不只是扩大采集规模，还包括如何把嘈杂的底层记录转换为截图—动作对、加入有用的反思式监督，并保留足够的来源信息以审计隐私、权利、反馈质量与可回放性。

核心审计问题是发布轨迹是否适合其预定用途。人类动作不必然最优；终局任务成功不能验证每个中间思考；离线动作匹配不等于整项任务成功；训练后模型表现强也不能证明每条数据都正确。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is an open pipeline from real human desktop behavior to multimodal supervised trajectories. AgentNetTool captures synchronized screen video, mouse and keyboard events, and accessibility trees on annotators' own machines. After manual upload and review, Action Reduction compresses redundant low-level events, while State-Action Matching chooses a visually distinct frame before mouse pre-movement so the screenshot does not leak the future cursor location. A terminal success or failure action is appended to the episode.

OpenCUA then adds three levels of supervision. L1 is the executable action, L2 is reflective reasoning, and L3 is a description of the observation. A reflector judges the preceding action using before/after screenshots and action code; a generator produces observation-thought-action text with task history, reflections, target action code, a red coordinate marker, and a zoomed crop; a summarizer refines the task and scores completion, alignment, efficiency, and difficulty. The disclosed teacher for all three roles is claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219.

This makes the feedback boundary explicit: humans author actions, a frontier model authors and judges reflective text, offline AgentNetBench matches predicted actions against curated valid actions, and online OSWorld-Verified uses environment-specific task checks. Training itself is supervised fine-tuning and distillation from human and model-authored traces, not reinforcement learning from an environment reward.

核心思路是建立一条从真实人类桌面行为到多模态监督轨迹的开放流水线。AgentNetTool 在标注者自己的设备上同步采集屏幕视频、鼠标与键盘事件以及 accessibility tree。人工上传和复核后，Action Reduction 压缩冗余的底层事件；State-Action Matching 则选择鼠标预移动之前、视觉上有区分度的帧，避免截图泄漏未来光标位置。每个 episode 最后附加成功或失败的终止动作。

OpenCUA 随后加入三个监督层级：L1 是可执行动作，L2 是反思式推理，L3 是对观察的描述。reflector 根据动作前后截图和动作代码判断上一步；generator 结合任务历史、反思、目标动作代码、红色坐标标记和局部放大图生成 observation-thought-action 文本；summarizer 细化任务，并为完成度、对齐度、效率和难度打分。三个角色均使用公开注明的 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219。

由此可以明确区分反馈边界：人类编写动作，前沿模型编写并判断反思文本，离线 AgentNetBench 将预测动作与人工整理的有效动作匹配，在线 OSWorld-Verified 使用任务特定的环境检查。训练本身是基于人类和模型轨迹的监督微调与蒸馏，而不是利用环境 reward 的强化学习。

title: Method
方法
html:
An episode begins with an English task instruction and an initial screenshot, followed by screenshots and PyAutoGUI-compatible actions such as clicking, moving, dragging, scrolling, typing, hotkeys, waiting, and success or failure termination. Annotators are drawn from student, crowdsourcing, and company pools; all reportedly sign consent. The paper prefers long tasks, rejects demonstrations shorter than five steps, separates Windows/macOS from Ubuntu collection, and states that Ubuntu tasks do not overlap OSWorld.

Raw recordings can contain thousands of input events. Rule-based Action Reduction merges scrolls, key sequences, hotkeys, drags, and double-clicks and inserts mouse movement preconditions where needed. State-Action Matching selects the frame immediately before pre-movement rather than the frame containing the final cursor location. The processed corpus contains 22,625 accepted tasks with a mean of 18.6 steps: about 12K Windows, 5K macOS, and 5K Ubuntu tasks. Table 2 separately reports 41,428 training trajectories for OpenCUA-7B/32B and 27,804 for Qwen2-7B/A3B, so task count must not be treated as the exact count of every training view.

The reflective pipeline labels each previous action as correct or incorrect and redundant or necessary. Steps judged incorrect or redundant are omitted from training. The released trajectory schema includes task identifiers and instructions; completion, alignment, efficiency, and difficulty fields; refined task descriptions; domain; and per-step screenshot, observation, thought, action description, action code, correctness, redundancy, reflection, step identifier, and marks. The official HF card documents multi-image chat formatting with loss only on the current assistant response.

Training mixes planning trajectories with GUI grounding and general SFT data. Sources include AgentNet, ShowUI, UGround, 189K accessibility-tree bounding boxes, Aguvis-style agent data, and Kimi general text/vision SFT. The 72B recipe additionally uses 8K Ubuntu rollouts generated by o3 with Jedi. Default inference uses three screenshots and L2 reflective reasoning. CoT decoding parameters, full split manifests, exact source revisions, and the complete training launcher remain unknown.

一个 episode 以英文任务指令和初始截图开始，随后是截图以及与 PyAutoGUI 兼容的动作，例如点击、移动、拖拽、滚动、输入、快捷键、等待和成功或失败终止。标注者来自学生、众包平台和公司；论文称所有人都签署了同意书。论文偏好长任务，拒绝少于五步的演示，将 Windows/macOS 与 Ubuntu 的采集分开，并称 Ubuntu 任务与 OSWorld 不重叠。

原始记录可能包含数千个输入事件。基于规则的 Action Reduction 合并滚动、连续按键、快捷键、拖拽和双击，并在需要时插入鼠标移动前置动作。State-Action Matching 选择预移动之前的帧，而不是已包含最终光标位置的帧。处理后的语料含 22,625 个获接收任务，平均 18.6 步：约 12K 个 Windows、5K 个 macOS 和 5K 个 Ubuntu 任务。Table 2 另行报告 OpenCUA-7B/32B 使用 41,428 条训练轨迹，Qwen2-7B/A3B 使用 27,804 条，因此不能把任务数当作每种训练视图的精确数量。

反思流水线把每个先前动作标为正确或错误、冗余或必要；被判为错误或冗余的步骤不进入训练。已发布的轨迹 schema 包含任务标识与指令、完成度、对齐度、效率、难度、细化后的任务描述、domain，以及逐步的截图、observation、thought、动作描述、动作代码、正确性、冗余性、reflection、步骤标识和 marks。官方 HF 卡还说明了多图 chat 格式，并且 loss 只作用于当前 assistant response。

训练把规划轨迹与 GUI grounding 和通用 SFT 数据混合。来源包括 AgentNet、ShowUI、UGround、189K 个 accessibility-tree bounding boxes、Aguvis 风格的 agent 数据，以及 Kimi 通用文本/视觉 SFT。72B 配方另外使用了由 o3 与 Jedi 生成的 8K 条 Ubuntu rollouts。默认推理使用三张截图和 L2 反思式推理。CoT 解码参数、完整 split manifest、精确来源版本以及完整训练 launcher 仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release is substantial. The official repository provides AgentNet processing and visualization utilities, the reflective CoT generator, model inference support, and AgentNetBench evaluation. AgentNet is available as Windows/macOS and Ubuntu JSONL plus metadata and image archives, and OpenCUA model checkpoints are published. On the checked 2026-07-21 snapshots, GitHub was pinned to dfc91ba89f700d10f26ec50362d308571482ab8b, AgentNet to d76ee50a63fad81cfdbe576416757d7c2091ed50, and OpenCUA-7B to a2efb7d2b104d477a4a2666a357e79550a28aafc.

On 369 OSWorld-Verified tasks, OpenCUA-72B reports 39.0% success at 15 steps, 44.9% at 50 steps, and 45.0% at 100 steps; OpenCUA-32B reports 29.7%, 34.1%, and 34.8%. On the 100-trajectory AgentNetBench, OpenCUA-7B reports 79.0 coordinate, 62.0 content, 44.3 function, and 75.2 average Step SR; OpenCUA-32B reports 81.9, 66.1, 55.7, and 79.1. AgentNetBench includes manually refined alternatives, but it remains a static first-action metric rather than an executed terminal-state test.

A controlled Qwen2-VL-7B ablation trained on 14K Windows/macOS plus 3K Ubuntu examples improves OSWorld-Verified success from 11.5% to 15.3% when reflective CoT is added. This is evidence that the recipe can improve one model under one setup; it does not establish that each rationale is faithful or that benchmark performance measures record-level data quality. The 72B result is additionally confounded by mixed public and general data, a larger training budget, and 8K o3+Jedi rollouts.

Collection disclosure is also meaningful evidence: Appendix C.2 reports 634 annotators, 24,095 uploads before verification, roughly six months of work, about USD 20K in human annotation cost, USD 0.6 in CoT cost per task, and about USD 32K total. These numbers clarify scale and cost, but no independent recount or complete record-level provenance manifest is released.

发布物相当完整。官方仓库提供 AgentNet 处理与可视化工具、反思式 CoT generator、模型推理支持和 AgentNetBench 评测。AgentNet 以 Windows/macOS 和 Ubuntu JSONL、metadata 及图像压缩包形式发布，OpenCUA 模型 checkpoint 也已公开。在 2026-07-21 核验的快照中，GitHub 固定为 dfc91ba89f700d10f26ec50362d308571482ab8b，AgentNet 固定为 d76ee50a63fad81cfdbe576416757d7c2091ed50，OpenCUA-7B 固定为 a2efb7d2b104d477a4a2666a357e79550a28aafc。

在 369 个 OSWorld-Verified 任务上，OpenCUA-72B 在 15、50、100 步预算下分别报告 39.0%、44.9% 和 45.0% 成功率；OpenCUA-32B 分别报告 29.7%、34.1% 和 34.8%。在包含 100 条轨迹的 AgentNetBench 上，OpenCUA-7B 的 coordinate、content、function 和 average Step SR 分别为 79.0、62.0、44.3 和 75.2；OpenCUA-32B 分别为 81.9、66.1、55.7 和 79.1。AgentNetBench 包含人工细化的备选有效动作，但仍是静态的首动作指标，而非执行后的终局状态测试。

一个受控的 Qwen2-VL-7B 消融实验使用 14K 个 Windows/macOS 与 3K 个 Ubuntu 样本，加入 reflective CoT 后，OSWorld-Verified 成功率从 11.5% 提升到 15.3%。这表明该配方在一个设置下能改善一个模型，但不能证明每条 rationale 都忠实，也不能把 benchmark 表现当作逐条数据质量测量。72B 结果还混合了公开数据、通用数据、更大训练预算和 8K 条 o3+Jedi rollouts。

采集披露本身也构成有意义的证据：Appendix C.2 报告 634 名标注者、验证前 24,095 次上传、约六个月工作、约 USD 20K 人工标注成本、每项任务 USD 0.6 的 CoT 成本以及约 USD 32K 总成本。这些数字澄清了规模与成本，但尚无独立复点或完整的逐记录来源 manifest。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
OpenCUA's contribution is the combination of real cross-platform desktop demonstrations, reduction of dense input streams, cursor-leakage-aware screenshot alignment, multi-level reflective supervision, open models, and both offline and online evaluation hooks. The data object is richer than static grounding: it links task, visual state history, executable action, model-generated reflection, trajectory scores, and explicit termination.

Individual ingredients have precedents. Aguvis develops unified pure-vision GUI agents and reasoning-oriented supervision; AgentTrek releases human web trajectories; OSWorld provides an interactive desktop evaluation environment; grounding datasets supply screenshot-to-coordinate labels. OpenCUA's difference is the integrated foundation stack and the breadth of human Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu workflows, not the invention of every component.

The most technically specific data innovation is State-Action Matching: it aligns an action with the frame before mouse pre-movement rather than one that already reveals the future coordinate. The reflective pipeline is also unusually inspectable because the released schema separates action code, observation, thought, correctness, redundancy, and reflection. That transparency makes post-hoc rationale risk auditable rather than making the rationale automatically trustworthy.

OpenCUA 的贡献在于把真实跨平台桌面演示、密集输入流压缩、防光标泄漏的截图对齐、多层级反思式监督、开放模型以及离线和在线评测接口组合为一个整体。其数据对象比静态 grounding 更丰富：它连接任务、视觉状态历史、可执行动作、模型生成的 reflection、轨迹分数与显式终止。

单个组成部分已有先例。Aguvis 研究统一的纯视觉 GUI agent 和推理型监督；AgentTrek 发布人类 web 轨迹；OSWorld 提供交互式桌面评测环境；grounding 数据集提供截图到坐标的标签。OpenCUA 的差异在于集成式 foundation stack，以及人类 Windows、macOS、Ubuntu 工作流的广度，而不是发明了每个单独组件。

最具体的数据技术创新是 State-Action Matching：它将动作与鼠标预移动之前的帧对齐，而不是与已经泄漏未来坐标的帧对齐。反思流水线也具有较强的可检查性，因为发布 schema 分开保存动作代码、observation、thought、正确性、冗余性与 reflection。这种透明度使事后合理化风险可被审计，而不是让 rationale 自动变得可信。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper explicitly notes that human collection is costly and hard to scale, demonstrators may lack application expertise or optimal shortcuts, and consent introduces selection bias. A broad corpus can still underrepresent specialized enterprise workflows, accessibility modes, languages other than English, or tasks that annotators are unwilling to record.

Reflective CoT is post-hoc supervision. The generator sees the target action code, and the reflector sees both the before and after screenshots. The text may therefore encode the observed outcome or rationalize an inefficient action rather than recover the human's reasoning. No published calibration establishes step-level error rates for the Claude reflector or the faithfulness of generated thoughts.

Privacy controls are concrete but incomplete for audit. Recordings stay local until manual upload; annotators review video, actions, and accessibility trees; private tasks are rejected; internal humans and GPT-4o perform two-stage screening with human confirmation. Per-record consent and redaction logs, privacy prompts, detector error rates, and deletion procedures are not public. MIT declarations for model, dataset, tools, and code also do not settle third-party rights in website or application UI content, fonts, icons, or user material visible in screenshots.

Reproduction remains partial. The repository releases CoT generation and offline evaluation code, but lists the training pipeline as unfinished. AgentNet does not bundle immutable OS images, application versions, website states, credentials, locale, resolution, or reset scripts. The current HF viewer fails because trajectory and metadata JSONL files have different schemas, and several README paths have drifted from the live tree. Static Step SR can reject alternative valid actions, while online success varies with network, CAPTCHA, screen state, and application updates.

论文明确指出，人类采集成本高且难以扩展，演示者可能缺乏应用专业知识或最优捷径，而同意参与机制会引入选择偏差。即使语料覆盖广，也仍可能低估专业企业工作流、无障碍交互模式、英语之外的语言，或标注者不愿录制的任务。

reflective CoT 是事后监督。generator 能看到目标动作代码，reflector 能看到动作前后的截图。因此，文本可能编码已经观察到的结果，或为低效动作作出合理化解释，而不是恢复人类的真实推理。公开材料没有给出 Claude reflector 相对于逐步专家标签的校准误差，也没有验证生成 thought 的忠实性。

隐私控制具体但尚不足以完成审计。记录在人工上传之前保留于本地；标注者复核视频、动作和 accessibility tree；私密任务会被拒绝；内部人员与 GPT-4o 执行两阶段筛查，并由人确认模型标记。逐记录同意与脱敏日志、隐私 prompt、detector 错误率和删除流程并未公开。模型、数据、工具和代码的 MIT 声明也不能解决截图中第三方网站或应用 UI、字体、图标或用户材料的权利问题。

复现仍然不完整。仓库发布了 CoT 生成和离线评测代码，但仍将训练流水线列为未完成。AgentNet 没有捆绑不可变的 OS image、应用版本、网站状态、credential、locale、resolution 或 reset script。当前 HF viewer 因轨迹 JSONL 与 metadata JSONL schema 不同而失败，README 中若干路径也已与 live tree 漂移。静态 Step SR 可能拒绝其他有效动作，在线成功率则会随网络、CAPTCHA、屏幕状态和应用更新而变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, OpenCUA is a high-value reference because it exposes most of the transformation chain: consented human recording, raw-event reduction, state-action alignment, privacy and quality review, reflective trace synthesis, step filtering, source mixing, SFT formatting, static action evaluation, and interactive task evaluation. It is useful for comparing where provenance or verifier errors can enter a multimodal agent dataset.

Researchers can reuse AgentNet for screenshot-conditioned action SFT, reflective-trace distillation, action grounding, offline policy comparison, trajectory analysis, or studying human mistakes and recovery. The released CoT generator is also a concrete starting point for alternative reflectors, rationale-faithfulness checks, and ablations that separate L1 actions, L2 reflections, and L3 observations.

Safe reuse requires narrower claims than the headline model scores. Pin the dataset and model revisions, parse trajectory and metadata JSONL separately, inspect rights and privacy for the intended domain, and retain the distinction between human actions and Claude-authored reasoning. For evaluation, treat AgentNetBench as first-choice step agreement and use a replayable environment for whole-task claims. Reproducing the paper's model training still requires unreleased launcher/configuration details and external source snapshots.

对于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 赛道，OpenCUA 是高价值参考，因为它公开了大部分转换链：经同意的人类记录、原始事件压缩、状态—动作对齐、隐私与质量复核、反思轨迹合成、步骤过滤、来源混合、SFT 格式、静态动作评测和交互式任务评测。它适合比较多模态 agent 数据集中来源或 verifier 错误会在哪一环进入。

研究者可以将 AgentNet 用于截图条件下的动作 SFT、反思轨迹蒸馏、动作 grounding、离线 policy 比较、轨迹分析，或研究人类错误与恢复。已发布的 CoT generator 也是构建替代 reflector、rationale 忠实性检查，以及区分 L1 动作、L2 reflection 和 L3 observation 的消融实验起点。

安全复用需要比模型 headline 分数更窄的结论。应固定 dataset 与 model revision，分别解析轨迹和 metadata JSONL，检查目标领域中的权利与隐私，并保持人类动作与 Claude 编写推理之间的区别。评测时，应把 AgentNetBench 视为首选步骤动作一致率，并使用可回放环境支撑整项任务结论。要复现论文中的模型训练，仍需要未发布的 launcher/configuration 细节和外部来源快照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2.1-2.3 with Appendix C first: they define the actual episode, action-reduction and state-matching transformations, annotator composition, consent, privacy review, scale, and cost.
  • Keep three count regimes separate: 22,625 accepted tasks; about 12K Windows, 5K macOS, and 5K Ubuntu tasks; and 41,428 or 27,804 training trajectories for different model recipes.
  • In Section 3, note exactly what the teacher observes. The generator sees the target action code and the reflector sees the next screenshot, so reflective CoT is useful post-hoc supervision, not demonstrated human cognition.
  • Read AgentNetBench and OSWorld-Verified as different contracts: the former matches a predicted low-level action on 100 held-out trajectories, while the latter executes agents on 369 tasks with task-specific environment scripts.
  • Before reuse, pin GitHub dfc91ba89f700d10f26ec50362d308571482ab8b, AgentNet d76ee50a63fad81cfdbe576416757d7c2091ed50, and OpenCUA-7B a2efb7d2b104d477a4a2666a357e79550a28aafc; then account for missing training code, mixed HF schemas, environment drift, and third-party UI rights.

• 先结合 Appendix C 阅读 Sections 2.1-2.3：这些部分定义了真实 episode、Action Reduction 与 State-Action Matching 转换、标注者组成、同意与隐私复核、规模和成本。
  • 严格区分三种数量口径：22,625 个获接收任务；约 12K 个 Windows、5K 个 macOS 和 5K 个 Ubuntu 任务；以及不同模型配方使用的 41,428 或 27,804 条训练轨迹。
  • 阅读 Section 3 时要注意 teacher 究竟看到了什么。generator 看得到目标动作代码，reflector 看得到下一张截图，因此 reflective CoT 是有用的事后监督，而不是人类认知过程的演示。
  • 将 AgentNetBench 和 OSWorld-Verified 视为不同合同：前者在 100 条留出轨迹上匹配预测的底层动作，后者则在 369 个任务上运行 agent，并使用任务特定的环境脚本。
  • 复用前固定 GitHub dfc91ba89f700d10f26ec50362d308571482ab8b、AgentNet d76ee50a63fad81cfdbe576416757d7c2091ed50 和 OpenCUA-7B a2efb7d2b104d477a4a2666a357e79550a28aafc，再处理训练代码缺失、HF schema 混合、环境漂移和第三方 UI 权利问题。
